title: BOX OF ASST DAVID EDDINGS BOOKS
findings: One box of fantasy paperbacks and trade paperbacks, mostly HarperCollins Voyager and Corgi reprints. Legible titles: David Eddings - Pawn of Prophecy, Queen of Sorcery, Magician's Gambit, Castle of Wizardry, Enchanters' End Game (Belgariad, Corgi pbks), Guardians of the West, King of the Murgos, Demon Lord of Karanda, Sorceress of Darshiva, The Seeress of Kell (Malloreon, Corgi pbks), The Tamuli omnibus (Fontana/HarperCollins pbk); David and Leigh Eddings - Polgara the Sorceress, The Rivan Codex, The Redemption of Althalus (large pbk), Crystal Gorge, The Younger Gods, The Elder Gods, The Treasured One (Dreamers series, Voyager trade pbks), plus a second copy of The Treasured One partly hidden; Christopher Paolini - Brisingr (Doubleday), Inheritance (Doubleday); Mickey Zucker Reichert - The Last of the Renshai; Mario Puzo - The Godfather (old pbk); Orson Scott Card - Ender's Game (worn pbk, read upside down, fairly confident). About 24 books. Spines partly hidden at the back of the box could not be read. All are mass-market or trade reprints of titles printed in huge numbers; no early or signed editions visible.
condition: Used, read copies; spine creasing and edge wear on older Corgi paperbacks, Godfather and Ender's Game paperbacks well worn, Althalus with chipped cover edge.
reason: Common Eddings and Paolini reprints; no edition worth real money under the book rule.
marks_read: Corgi, HarperCollins Voyager, Fontana, Doubleday spine logos

title: QTY OF ASST BOOKS & BOX OF ASST BOOKS & DVDS
findings: Two boxes. Box 1 (manga and anime): Shinobu Ohtaka - Magi vols 1 to 7 (VIZ, English); two volumes of a series with stylised title, probably The Seven Deadly Sins vols 1 and 2 (Nakaba Suzuki, Kodansha), not certain; Loveless (Yun Kouga, Tokyopop, volume number unclear); We Never Learn vol 10; The Darwin Incident vol 1; My Girlfriend's Not Here Today vol 1; Takehiko Inoue - Vagabond (standard volume) and Vagabond VIZBIG Edition vol 1; Orphen anime DVDs vols 1 to 6 and Saiyuki Reload anime DVDs vols 1 to 7 (Madman, Australian ratings), small chibi figure, sticker and a figure phone holder in box. Box 2 (older paper): The Girl's Own Annual, red cloth with inset photograph of an Edwardian young woman, likely c.1905-1915 volume (year not visible); Gregory's Sydney Street Directory, pictorial card cover, probably 1960s-70s edition (edition number not legible); an unidentified older children's picture book or annual with painted cover showing a large round white face, toys and a golliwog figure (no title visible); a stack of thin paper items under it (magazines or comics, not legible); a blue children's book or folder cover printed with girls dancing in a line (no title visible); loose sheets beside the annual. No signed, limited or early Australiana titles visible.
condition: Girl's Own Annual cloth faded and rubbed, corners worn; street directory cover scuffed and stained; children's picture book cover rubbed and edge worn; manga and DVDs look clean.
reason: Unidentified vintage children's picture book with golliwog cover, Edwardian Girl's Own Annual and paper stack, plus a run of Magi and Vagabond VIZBIG manga; worth a closer look.
